title: The $50 Million Deal Blockbuster Laughed At (Demo)
description:
DEMO render of the Sneaky Deals long-form engine. Not for publishing.

In 2000, Netflix's founders offered to sell their company to Blockbuster for $50 million. Blockbuster said no. Ten years later it was bankrupt.
